name: Harbor
tagline: Everything you saved, safe in one place.
about:
Harbor keeps the links, notes and files you save from everywhere in one calm, searchable place, and gets them back to you when you need them.

The mark is a harbour mouth seen head on: an arch for shelter and a single beacon inside it, the thing you saved, waiting where you left it.
construction: On a 256 grid: an arch of outer radius 104 and band 36 whose legs run straight to the baseline, and a beacon of radius 26 on the centre line, its top just above the spring of the arch.
